name: Cable Side Bend
steps: Stand sideways to a low pulley holding its handle beside the near thigh with your feet planted.
Let your torso bend slightly toward the pulley, then draw your ribs away from it to straighten.
Ease back toward the pulley to begin the next bend.
Switch sides and repeat the movement.
tips: Keep your chest facing forward and your pelvis level.
Move straight sideways without leaning forward or twisting your torso.
